NPS Emmons-Winthrop route brief: season runs from late May (White River Road opening) to August when crevasses open; guide sources put the best conditions late May to early July; Jun 29 ascent in season.

track.why: Logged as Emmons-Winthrop (our route name); report describes two nights at Camp Schurman, the Steamboat Prow scramble and the Emmons Corridor; track starts and ends at White River and reaches the summit within 10 m of our pin; Jun 29 is inside the late May-Aug window.

facts.text: In late June and July the scramble between Steamboat Prow and the glacier funnels parties and rains loose rock on those below; keep clear of the fall line.
In mid-July the crevasses and snow bridge near 11,500 ft on the Corridor were cracking and settling; a collapse there can close the route for the year.
In July the lower glacier above Camp Schurman held widening crevasses, and a rope was needed for that stretch.
In July one crevasse around 12,200-12,500 ft was a leap or a narrow, slightly tilted snow bridge; protect it before crossing.
In late June, join the ranger conditions talk at Camp Schurman in the late afternoon; the preferred line and bridge condition change week to week.
In late June do not follow every bootpack blindly: sagging bridges pushed parties to end-run, so the track shifts.
A couple of pickets for running protection at crevasse crossings (June-July)
In July the scree below Camp Curtis becomes a one-at-a-time bottleneck; in warm weather a long glissade chute helped the lower Inter Glacier descent.

notes: Only 15 harvested tracks, almost all on Emmons-Winthrop, the Disappointment Cleaver (from Paradise, already tracked) and a few unlabeled Paradise-start ones. No track names Curtis, Fuhrer, Kautz, Liberty, Ptarmigan, Tahoma, Sunset, Mowich or Edmunds, so only Emmons-Winthrop gets one. Paradise-start complete tracks in the Fuhrer Finger/Thumb checks are DC ascents, not those routes. Two entries in this packet (South Tahoma Headwall, Tahoma Cleaver) have no trailhead or waypoints and carry a wa_glacier_peak_ id prefix although they are Rainier lines: likely misfiled. Mowich Face has a stored season (Jun-Aug) that disagrees with its best-season text (May-June). No pin proposed; the Emmons trailhead pin already sits within ~10 m of the track start.
